dialogueText: Right, where were we...Page 1250...
...YES! Page 1250, how to make Affection Potion!
Affection Potion is the milder version of the Love Potion. If you want just one more glance from your dear crush, consider this potion.
To make 250mL of Affection Potion, you'll need...
Yeah yeah. I know this already.
5 cherries, 3 sparkle frogs, 6 oranges, and...
and...the FLOWER of the dreaded Jormungandr!
Man...I'm about to piss my pants just thinking about it, but I can't let Charlie fall for someone else.
I've waited, what, 5 years just to get him to notice me. I can't wait any longer!
...Okay. I'm ready. This shouldn't be too hard.
Let's make that Affection Potion for Charlie.
A python. Does that mean...
JORMUNGANDR IS DOWN THERE?
OKAY I'M NOT READY THOUGH IHAVETOGOBUTIMNOTREADY
...? What is that?
Hey Charlie!
Mmm? Oh, it's you.
Where were you? You were gone for few days. I was worried.
Huh? You were worried about me? Why?
Hm? Why wouldn't I be?
Anyways, what's up? Did you need help with something?
Oh no, I just wanted to give this juice(?) I made for you. It took me awhile, but hope you like it.
Sweet! Thank you, I love how you always know what I need. But...
Seriously, please don't go into dangerous places anymore. I don't want to see you hurt. I...I care about you. Way more than you think.
Oh. OH. (He didn't even drink the potion yet. Why is he so sweet to me all of a sudden?)
W-wait. By you caring about me, you mean...you...
Yes. I care about you, because I like you.
